prompt:
Build a closed-loop Simulink model of an unpowered lifting body that performs an automatic atmospheric approach, follows a physically feasible descent path, executes a flare, and reaches the runway with bounded terminal speed, sink rate, attitude, and alignment. The basic system must contain a finite-mass six-degree-of-freedom rigid-body airframe, atmosphere and wind, nonlinear aerodynamic forces and moments, air-data and inertial/navigation measurements, approach and flare guidance, feedback control, and bounded dynamic aerodynamic-surface actuators. Vehicle motion must result from the connected aerodynamic, actuator, and rigid-body paths; prescribed or replayed position histories are not valid.

Read InitialAirspeedScale, InitialBankOffset_deg, VehicleMassScale, and WindSeverityScale from the MATLAB base workspace and support their full stated ranges.

InitialAirspeedScale, VehicleMassScale, and WindSeverityScale are finite real scalars in [0.97, 1.03], [0.95, 1.05], and [0.7, 1.3], respectively; InitialBankOffset_deg is a finite real scalar in [-3, 3] deg. The vehicle has no sustained propulsion available during the evaluated approach, so its trajectory and terminal condition must be achieved through physically consistent energy management and aerodynamic control. The control architecture is otherwise your choice.

Record complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named landing_state, guidance_command, surface_command_deg, and surface_position_deg. landing_state has 16 channels in this order: north, east, and down position (m); north, east, and down velocity (m/s); roll, pitch, and yaw (rad); body roll, pitch, and yaw rate (rad/s); angle of attack (rad); sideslip angle (rad); Mach number; and dynamic pressure (Pa). guidance_command has 3 channels in this order: roll demand, angle-of-attack demand, and sideslip demand, all in deg. surface_command_deg has 6 channels in this order: aileron, elevator, rudder, positive body-flap, negative body-flap, and differential body-flap demand, all in deg. surface_position_deg has the corresponding 6 achieved surface positions in the same order and units. The guidance and actuator records must be the signals causally connected to the same measured airframe trajectory. Save the completed model as cand_XAERO06.slx in the submission directory.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XAERO06.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
